improvedVsOld: The new text is clearly better than the old across the batch. It fixes the calques the style guide calls out ('Há duas espécies', 'alojamento com telhado', 'estações' for stations, 'Verificar o atual conta', 'Cada local abre com o detalhe que decide'). It replaces 'parques de caravanas', 'concelho'/'shire' misuse and 'Destacados/Quero ir/Marcadores' with the glossary terms and app labels, and changes 'tarifa' to 'preço' and 'meteorologia' to 'o tempo' in the UI. Every 'offline' claim in the changed keys becomes 'abre sem rede' / 'vem dentro da app', and 'datados' becomes 'com a data de verificação'. It adds the required first-use glosses (roadhouse, bottle shop, honesty box, NPWS, total fire ban, Country, Traditional Owners, award wage, schooner). Article titles and descriptions now lead with search terms ('Dormir no carro na Austrália', 'Comer fora na Austrália', 'Transportes públicos na Austrália'). Register is a consistent informal tu, with no você, no em dashes and no Brazilianisms in the changed values. Prose is idiomatic pt-PT ('paredes-meias', 'é uma lotaria', 'Se conduzires, não bebas', 'Poder estacionar não é poder dormir'). All numbers, prices, dates and placeholders match EN, apart from the misaligned privacy keys. The weak spots: three UI meta descriptions are well over 160 characters, a couple of headings drift from the meaning, and 'mapa padrão'/'meteorologia' are used inconsistently between the support page and the UI.
criticalIssues: The Portuguese privacy page does not match the English structure. pt has 6 sections and EN has 7: the whole 'Website analytics' (GA4) section and its 4 paragraphs are missing, every later heading and paragraph is shifted by one, there is an orphan key pages.privacy.sections[5].paragraphs[1], and the effective date says 12 August 2026 where EN says 19 October 2026. lib/localized.ts isPageComplete() therefore fails, so getPage() serves the whole page in English and /pt/privacy stays non-indexable. The branch retranslated these keys without realigning them, so that work is wasted. The gap existed on main before this branch, but this branch should fix it.

The consent.* strings (label, message, accept, decline, learnMore, privacyChoices) are missing from pt.json, so Portuguese (EU) visitors see the GA4 consent bar in English. This gap also existed on main before the branch.

Not part of this diff, but the site is now inconsistent: the new ui.faq5a/feature1Text use the app labels Com estrela / Quero visitar / Pins / Todos os guardados, while the untouched articles save-collections-aussiecamps, aussiecamps-widgets-guide and best-camping-app-australia still say Destacados / Quero ir / Marcadores / Tudo o que guardaste. ui.review1Quote still contains 'salvar' and 'offline', 'autossuficiente' remains in aussiecamps-place-details, and 'conselho' remains in 5 untouched keys. These need a follow-up batch.
